categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Yuma Sun-shading Technology Corp., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of functional sun-shading materials. Its main product categories include blackout fabrics, adjustable light fabrics, and solar fabrics, which are used in indoor and outdoor shading for residential, commercial, and public buildings. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in related fields such as solar power generation and high-performance fiber manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as water-based acrylic emulsions, polymer composite coatings, and specialized weaving techniques including multi-layer and jacquard weaving. It employs high-end imported equipment like German DORNIER and Italian SMIT looms and advanced coating lines. Core technologies include high polymer material granulation, eco-friendly water-based foaming coatings, and precision control in fabric weight and curvature, supported by over 150 patents and collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuma Technology serves manufacturers of finished sun-shading products, targeting mid-to-high-end markets globally. Its customers include producers of curtains, blinds, and architectural shading systems, with products widely used in office buildings, hotels, shopping malls, stadiums, hospitals, and residential properties. The company maintains long-term relationships with clients across more than 70 countries and regions on six continents, with a strong presence in Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shouguang City, Shandong Province, and has established subsidiaries in the United States (California and Texas). Its sales are global, with approximately 69% of revenue from overseas markets including Europe, Asia, and the Americas, and the remainder from domestic Chinese markets, mainly concentrated in East and South China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuma Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of functional sun-shading materials. It procures raw materials such as polyester fiber, water-based acrylic emulsions, and PVC from upstream suppliers and sells finished fabrics directly to downstream sun-shading product manufacturers. The company manages procurement, production, quality control, and direct sales, emphasizing a 'make-to-order' production model with some inventory for market responsiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly sun-shading materials. R&D focuses include high-strength polymer composite fabrics, high-reflectivity and heat-insulating materials, recycled fiber textiles, sound-absorbing fabrics, multifunctional coatings, and automation in production. It aims to expand product categories, enhance product quality, and develop intelligent manufacturing capabilities to maintain industry leadership and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of functional sun-shading fabrics to manufacturers of finished shading products. The company operates a buyout sales model, fulfilling orders based on customer contracts. Approximately 70% of revenue comes from exports, with the remainder from domestic sales. The company also earns minor income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its core business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuma Technology is a leading domestic player and recognized industry leader in China's functional sun-shading materials sector. It holds a top-tier market position with advanced technology, strong brand recognition, and extensive global customer relationships. Competitors include both domestic mid-tier and small-scale manufacturers, as well as international established brands like Hunter Douglas and Phifer in developed markets. The company differentiates itself through innovation, quality, and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 769 million, a 16% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 186 million, up 12%. Total assets reached RMB 1.54 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.44 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profit, and production capacity, supported by expanding domestic and international markets and ongoing investments in production and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuma Technology emphasizes high-quality, multifunctional, and environmentally friendly sun-shading materials that combine shading, energy saving, and special features such as antibacterial, anti-pollution, formaldehyde removal, and flame retardancy. Its products offer superior durability, precise light control, and aesthetic appeal, supported by advanced manufacturing processes and strict quality control. The company’s ability to rapidly respond to diverse global customer needs and provide customized solutions strengthens its competitive advantage.
